# Differences compare.py lets through: the ones the port makes on purpose.
#
#   KIND PATH-PATTERN [KEY-PATTERN] -- UPSTREAM.md: TEXT
#
# KIND is only-py, only-go, size, content, tags, stream or unreadable. In the
# patterns * matches any run of characters, / included, and ? one character.
# TEXT must appear in UPSTREAM.md, in the row that explains the difference.
# compare.py's docstring has the details.
#
# Empty, since the parity runs of 2026-11-04 found no difference.
